verses.pali: “Cha, bhikkhave, dhamme appahāya abhabbo uttari manussadhammaṁ alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṁ sacchikātuṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, without giving up six qualities you can’t realize a superhuman distinction in knowledge and vision worthy of the noble ones.

verses.pali: Muṭṭhassaccaṁ, asampajaññaṁ, indriyesu aguttadvārataṁ, bhojane amattaññutaṁ, kuhanaṁ, lapanaṁ.
verses.english: Lack of mindfulness and situational awareness, not guarding the sense doors, eating too much, fawning, and flattery.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo uttari manussadhammaṁ alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṁ sacchikātuṁ.
verses.english: Without giving up these six qualities you can’t realize a superhuman distinction in knowledge and vision worthy of the noble ones.

verses.pali: Cha, bhikkhave, dhamme pahāya bhabbo uttari manussadhammaṁ alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṁ sacchikātuṁ.
verses.english: But after giving up six qualities you can realize a superhuman distinction in knowledge and vision worthy of the noble ones.

verses.pali: Muṭṭhassaccaṁ, asampajaññaṁ, indriyesu aguttadvārataṁ, bhojane amattaññutaṁ, kuhanaṁ, lapanaṁ.
verses.english: Lack of mindfulness and situational awareness, not guarding the sense doors, eating too much, fawning, and flattery.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo uttari manussadhammaṁ alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṁ sacchikātun”ti.
verses.english: After giving up these six qualities you can realize a superhuman distinction in knowledge and vision worthy of the noble ones.”
